content: React charting 2025/2026: Recharts remains the default React-native pick (48.9M weekly downloads), React-first component API, SVG rendering, good for line/bar/treemap/sparkline at moderate data volumes; gzip ~50KB, now on v3.x (major rewrite of internal state, see 3.0 migration guide). Nivo offers more chart-type variety and built-in theming but larger bundle. visx (Airbnb) is low-level D3+React primitives, ~15KB but steep learning curve, best for fully custom visualizations. Lightweight Charts (TradingView) is canvas-based, extremely high-performance for large time-series/candlestick data but not a general-purpose component chart library (no treemap) and awkward for typical dashboard bar/line/sparkline needs — do not use it for a general dashboard, prefer Recharts.
